about: Rows of the master catalogue whose circuits are too long to store as columns. Each row has every field of a row of master_catalog.json except columns, plus construction, the rule that builds the columns (master_catalog/constructions.py), and columns_sha256, the SHA-256 of those columns as compact JSON in the order the rule fixes. rotation_powers is one digit per column, the power of T it runs at (1, 3, 5 or 7), or null. The header of master_catalog.json applies to these rows too: regimes, discovery, references and the rest.

families.two-group: Singh, Gidney and Jones (arXiv:2606.28518): outputs 0..k-1, checks k..N-1; one T rotation on A | B for every set A of outputs and every non-empty set B of checks with (|A| = 0 or |A| = 1 mod s_O) and |A| + |B| = 1 mod s_total; columns sorted ascending, then the list sorted lexicographically
